description: List the non-system schemas in a registered foreign Postgres connection. Requires connection_name. System schemas (pg_catalog, information_schema, pg_toast) are excluded. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) — the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the job finishing; the schema list itself is delivered when the job completes.
embedding_description: List the user schemas in a registered external Postgres database, leaving internal system namespaces out. The TOP level of foreign-database introspection -- the first call when orienting inside an unfamiliar database. Dispatches asynchronously; the schema-name list arrives via job completion, not this call's own return.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the schema list — that arrives separately when the job completes and is delivered as its own message.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the job was queued — do not present job_id/status as the answer to 'what schemas exist'. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the schema list itself lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, list the schema names (schema metadata, data_sensitivity 0.1) and suggest list_tables with a schema to go deeper.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List the non-system schemas of a registered foreign Postgres connection.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: external_pg.invalid_params: missing connection_name. external_pg.connection_unknown: no connection registered under that name. external_pg.auth_failed / external_pg.permission_denied: the registered credential was rejected. external_pg.platform_db_refused: the connection targets the platform's own database.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: external_pg.connection_unknown: run list_connections. external_pg.auth_failed/permission_denied: ask the operator to re-check the registered connection.
